constraint.definition: vertical current-centre row, matrix-led over the active mapping

edits.warm_seed_source: converged base frame at the shot current

seed_probe_definition: one trip closed with zero Newton steps on this edit's current vector, seeded from the state the edit starts from; the reported residual is the seed's own residual on the edited operator, measured without the vertical current-centre row so it stays the same quantity every earlier sweep recorded
